_note: ontvangstbevestiging (Awb 4:3a). The acknowledgement of receipt is DECLARED on the case type and never drawn into a workflow (design D-1): a case type that forgets a workflow step breaks a statutory duty silently, and a declaration cannot be forgotten by omission because it carries a default. The case gains the record of what was sent and the state of the duty, so 'did we confirm receipt' is answered from the case rather than from a server log (design D-8). A fragment rather than an edit to dossiq_register.json, per ADR-037, because three dossiq lanes build against this file at once.

acknowledgement.title: Acknowledgement of receipt
acknowledgement.description: When a case of this type owes the sender an acknowledgement of receipt, and how it is sent. Awb 4:3a owes one to every electronically submitted message, so the default is on and the default channel list is every electronic intake channel. A case typed at the balie owes nothing unless this declaration says so.

enabled.title: Send an acknowledgement of receipt
enabled.description: Off only where the law does not ask for one. Turning it off warns on publication and names Awb 4:3a.

statutory.title: Statutory
statutory.description: Marks this as the Awb 4:3a duty rather than a courtesy, so it cannot be removed unnoticed.

intakeChannels.title: Intake channels that owe one
intakeChannels.description: The values of case.intakeChannel that owe an acknowledgement. The default is every electronic channel: mail, the portal and the API.

defaultChannel.title: Default channel
defaultChannel.description: The channel used when the citizen recorded no choice of their own.

contentOnPlatform.title: Content stays on the platform
contentOnPlatform.description: On, the e-mail says a message is waiting and carries no case content. The Berichtenbox pattern, decided once per case type rather than per template.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language the acknowledgement is written in. Dutch unless this case type declares another.

notificationMoments.title: Automatic messages
notificationMoments.description: The moments at which the applicant is told something without a handler acting. The entry for case-received carries the statutory flag and is the Awb 4:3a acknowledgement. Asking the applicant for something is its own moment, distinct from a status change, because informing and chasing are not the same message.

template.title: Template
template.description: The template rendered at this moment.

acknowledgementDuty.title: Acknowledgement of receipt
acknowledgementDuty.description: Whether this case owes an acknowledgement of receipt, and whether it was met. A failed send is a state here rather than a line in the application log, because somebody has to perform the duty by hand once the retries run out.

outboundCommunications.title: Outbound communications
outboundCommunications.description: What this case sent the applicant on its own, one entry per message: the moment, the channel, the recipient and the version of the template it was rendered from. Cluster 23's outbound log renders these rather than keeping a second set.
